account_frozen: Account progression is frozen for this launch. Nothing done here is saved.
account_counts: This launch counts toward account progress.
account_help: The progression freeze in Obsidian, under Guardrails, keeps the account as it is. It applies from the next launch.
abort_help: Leaves the mission and returns to the ship, as from the pause menu.
add_patrol_help: Sends one more patrol out from a patrol spawner on the map.
any_arrow_on: Any arrow calls the chosen stratagem
any_arrow_on_help: The first arrow of any stratagem code calls the stratagem chosen below.
any_arrow_pick_help: The stratagem any arrow calls. Choosing one also switches the option above on.
applies_loadout: Takes effect at the next mission or respawn.
applies_reload: Takes effect at the next spawn, or at once with Apply to weapons in play.
applies_spawn: Takes effect at the next spawn.
applies_use: Takes effect at the next use.
apply_now_help: Some numbers reach a weapon only when it spawns. This pushes them into the weapons already out.
armor_help: Any armor look from the base game or an owned DLC, unlocked or not. Looks only: protection stays the same.
armor_value_help: Each hit on the player loses this much damage, head-on or glancing. A Helldiver normally has 0 head-on and 35 glancing.
blast_cursor_help: Sets off the explosion under the mouse cursor. As with any blast in the game, it hurts players in range too.
blast_power_help: Damage at the center of the explosion, before armor. The outer part deals half.
blast_radius_help: Reach of the explosion in meters. The inner third deals full power.
blind_help: Enemies stop picking targets, so they leave players alone. In co-op, pair with Keep new enemies on the host.
bot_add_bare_help: A Helldiver body with no player slot, HUD or respawn, to fight beside or shoot at.
bot_add_help: A Helldiver run by this game, with a HUD slot, revives and reinforcements. Once every player slot is taken, the next one is a bare Helldiver.
bot_add_named: Add a bot with a name
bot_add_named_help: Same as Add a bot, with the typed name shown over the head and in the HUD.
bot_aim_cursor_help: Keeps facing the point under the mouse while no enemy is in reach.
bot_aim_free_help: Ends Face the cursor, so the bot looks where it walks.
bot_call: Call a stratagem at the cursor
bot_call_help: A real call-in made by the bot under the mouse cursor, so the kills count for the bot. Spends no cooldown or use.
bot_calm_all_help: Every bot holds fire. Walking orders still work.
bot_come_help: Moves to 2 meters in front of the player at once.
bot_fight_all_help: Every bot aims at and shoots the nearest enemy within 25 meters.
bot_fight_help: Aims at and shoots the nearest enemy within 25 meters.
bot_follow_help: Stays within 6 meters of the player, walking over when further away.
bot_give_stratagem_help: Puts the stratagem in the stratagem slots of the bot.
bot_go_cursor_help: Walks to the point under the mouse and stops. Bots walk straight, so a rock in the way stops them.
bot_heal_help: Up from downed and at full health.
bot_hold_help: Stays in place until the next walking order.
bot_no_body: Not on the field: in a hellpod, or dead.
bot_refill_help: Full ammunition for every weapon the bot holds.
bot_reload_help: Reloads the weapon in hand, as the reload key does.
bot_remove_all_help: Takes every bot out of the mission, bare Helldivers included.
bot_remove_help: Takes the bot out of the mission and frees the player slot.
bot_remove_perk_help: Leaves the bot with no perk.
bot_shoot_help: Keeps firing the weapon in hand until switched off.
bot_switch_help: Changes to the next weapon the bot carries.
bot_throw_help: Throws one grenade where the bot faces.
call_cursor_help: A real flare under the mouse cursor, with the sound and countdown, and patrols hear it. Spends no cooldown or use.
call_delay_help: Seconds added to the countdown of the flares below, on top of the stratagem call-in time.
call_encounter_help: Sets off an enemy alarm 10 meters ahead, as when a patrol spots the squad, and waves of enemies come.
camera_angle_help: How steeply the camera looks down, in degrees, where 90 is straight down. Missions start at 65.
camera_distance_help: How far the camera sits from the players. Missions start at 17.
camera_fov_help: How wide the camera sees, in degrees. Missions start at 60.
camera_spin_help: Turns the camera around the players, in degrees. Missions start at -45. Mouse aim still works.
cape_help: Any cape from the base game or an owned DLC, unlocked or not.
changes_edits_off_help: Puts every value changed in the Editor back as the game has it.
changes_effects_off_help: Turns off every option listed above at once.
changes_keep_help: Saves the weapon, enemy, stratagem and status edits listed above. They return at each launch while Keep saved edits is on.
clear_decals: Clean up blood and scorch marks
clear_decals_help: Removes the marks that shots and blasts leave on the ground.
collect_samples_help: Every research sample on the map counts as picked up by the player.
console_none: None on this screen. Most commands come with a mission.
console_type_help: A developer command left in the game, typed with any arguments. Commands that reach the shared war, wipe saves or unlock paid content are refused.
custom_also_help: Called down at the same spot, at the upgrade level the player owns. Choosing one sets When it lands to call it.
custom_base_help: The game stratagem to copy. Other players always see this one when the new stratagem is called.
custom_call_help: A real flare under the mouse cursor, as with any stratagem. Spends no cooldown or use.
custom_call_in_help: Seconds from the flare landing to the drop.
custom_code_bad: A code is 1 to 10 arrows: up, down, left and right, or W, A, S and D.
custom_code_help: Up to 10 arrows. Arrow keys or W A S D add one, Backspace removes the last, Enter confirms. Older Obsidian versions take typed up, down, left, right or W A S D.
custom_cooldown_help: Wait after each call before the next. Starts at the cooldown of the base stratagem.
custom_does_help: An extra effect where the flare lands: an explosion, a stun on enemies within 12 meters, full health for all players, or a second stratagem.
custom_drop_nothing_help: Only the effect chosen above happens. The base stratagem drops no hellpod or strike.
custom_forget_help: Removes the stratagem from the next launch on. A loadout that holds it gets the default stratagem in that slot.
custom_forgotten: Erased from the next launch on
custom_icon_help: The HUD and Loadout icon, borrowed from any game stratagem.
custom_make_help: The new stratagem shows in the Loadout screen wherever the base one is unlocked, while session mods are on.
custom_title_help: Shown wherever the game names the stratagem, up to 40 characters.
custom_uses_help: Calls allowed in one mission. 0 keeps the number of the base stratagem.
custom_workshop_help: A stratagem built on one of the game stratagems, with a new name, code, icon, numbers and landing effect. Kept for later launches.
damage_to_enemies_help: Multiplies the damage enemies take, after armor, so a shot that armor stops still does nothing. All players should set the same number.
damage_to_players_help: Multiplies the damage players take, after armor. Each game in the lobby works out some of the hits, so all players should set the same number.
despawn_all_help: Enemies vanish with no corpse and no kill credit, so objectives don't count them.
drop_carried_help: Puts down an object the player carries, such as a hard drive.
drop_cursor_help: The hellpod or strike arrives under the mouse cursor at once, with no flare. Reinforce needs a real flare.
edit_backpacks_help: Game data of each backpack, such as how many uses it holds.
edit_character_help: Speeds, stamina, landing time, health and armor of every Helldiver.
edit_enemies_help: Game data of each enemy type, such as health and armor. In co-op, pair with Keep new enemies on the host.
edit_grenades_help: Game data of each grenade type, such as the fuse and the throw distance.
edit_mine_help: The single mine an explosive minefield lays, with a separate arming delay.
edit_mine_stun_help: The single mine a stun minefield lays, with a separate arming delay.
edit_mines_help: Mines per drop for each minefield, and the arming delay of each mine.
edit_primaries_help: Game data of each primary weapon, at every upgrade level. Every copy of that weapon in this game changes.
edit_sentries_help: Ammunition, damage, range, tracking and lifetime of each sentry.
edit_sidearms_help: Game data of each sidearm, at every upgrade level. Every copy of that weapon in this game changes.
edit_statuses_help: Damage, duration and slow of each status effect, such as burning or poison.
edit_stratagems_help: Cooldown, uses and call-in delay of each stratagem, at every upgrade level.
edit_strikes_help: Bombs, barrages, strafing runs and beams of each air and orbital strike.
edit_support_help: Game data of each support weapon, at every upgrade level. Every copy of that weapon in this game changes.
edit_vehicles_help: Speed, turning, armor and health of each vehicle.
enemy_difficulty_help: Alarms send waves bought from a budget that follows the mission difficulty. This sets the budget from 1 to 15 instead. 0 keeps the mission default.
exposure_help: Brightness of the scene. 1 is the planet default.
fast_extract_help: The beacon, shuttle and boarding go by at once. The objectives still have to be done first.
fast_mission_start_help: The drop starts as soon as the mission has loaded, with no minimum wait on the loading screen.
fast_pods_help: Hellpods land almost the moment the call-in ends.
field_airstrike_bomb_area_length_help: Length in meters of the line the bombs fall along, evenly spaced.
field_airstrike_num_bombs_help: Bombs per air strike. The first upgrade raises this to 8.
field_airstrike_time_until_bombs_help: Seconds from the call-in to the first bomb.
field_artillery_diameter_help: Size in meters of the square the shells land in.
field_artillery_duration_help: Seconds the barrage keeps firing. Shell damage isn't editable here.
field_artillery_salvo_rounds_help: Shells fired in each salvo of the barrage.
field_backpack_num_uses_help: Uses a backpack has when first picked up.
field_backpack_num_uses_max_help: The cap that refills and resupplies stop at.
field_character_armor_max_help: Armor against glancing hits, 35 by default. Head-on hits meet none.
field_character_dive_duration_help: Seconds a dive lasts. 0.8 by default.
field_character_get_up_presses_needed_he: Button presses to get back up from downed. 30 by default.
field_character_health_help: Hitpoints of every Helldiver. 100 by default.
field_character_move_speed_aim_help: Movement while aiming or firing. 1.5 by default.
field_character_move_speed_crawl_help: Speed while crawling, as when downed. 1.5 by default.
field_character_move_speed_dive_help: How fast a dive carries the player. 10 by default.
field_character_move_speed_jog_help: Speed when moving without sprinting. 4 by default.
field_character_move_speed_sprint_max_he: Top speed while sprinting. 7 by default.
field_character_move_speed_sprint_min_he: Sprint speed once stamina runs low. 5 by default.
field_character_spawn_time_help: Seconds from the hellpod landing until the player can move. 5.4 by default.
field_character_sprint_stamina_help: Seconds of sprinting on full stamina. 5 by default.
field_enemy_health_help: Health of this enemy type, worn down by each hit after armor.
field_enemy_radius_help: Size in meters of the area the enemy melee attack covers.
field_explosive_blast_radius_help: Outer reach of the explosion in meters. Blast damage applies out to here.
field_firearm_magazine_capacity_help: Rounds in one magazine. A bigger magazine fills at the next reload.
field_firearm_reload_duration_help: Seconds to reload once the magazine is empty.
field_grenade_throw_distance_max_help: Farthest a full-strength throw goes, in meters.
field_grenade_time_until_explosion_help: Seconds from the throw to the blast.
field_launcher_magazine_capacity_help: Rounds in one magazine. A bigger magazine fills at the next reload.
field_melee_power_help: Damage of a melee hit, before armor.
field_melee_radius_help: Size in meters of the area a melee hit covers.
field_mine_num_mines_help: Mines one minefield call-in lays. More mines sit closer together.
field_mine_time_until_armed_help: Seconds after landing before the mine can go off.
field_orbital_alive_time_help: Seconds the orbital beam keeps burning.
field_orbital_max_velocity_help: How fast the beam moves to follow targets.
field_status_amount_help: Speed drops to 1 minus this: 0 is no slow, 1 stops the target. Carry burden is the slowdown from carrying an object.
field_strafing_duration_help: Seconds the strafing run keeps firing.
field_strafing_power_help: Damage of each strafing shot, before armor.
field_toughness_armor_max_help: Damage a glancing hit loses to armor. Head-on hits meet less armor.
field_toughness_health_help: Hitpoints, worn down by each hit after armor.
field_turret_check_for_enemies_radius_he: Meters within which the sentry finds targets.
field_turret_power_help: Damage of each sentry shot, before armor.
field_turret_rounds_help: Shots before the sentry runs dry.
field_turret_turn_speed_target_help: How fast the sentry turns to follow a target.
field_vehicle_acceleration_help: How fast the vehicle reaches top speed.
field_vehicle_deceleration_help: How fast the vehicle slows to a stop.
field_vehicle_move_speed_help: Fastest the vehicle goes. A driver already inside gets out and back in for it.
field_vehicle_turn_speed_help: Exosuits: a number under 1, lower is quicker. Other vehicles: degrees per second.
finish_objectives_help: Completes every objective, boss fights included. Extraction still has to be called.
fog_color_help: Tints the fog. Only this screen changes.
free_camera_bounds_help: The camera keeps going past the edges of the map instead of stopping there.
free_stratagems_help: No cooldowns, and calling a stratagem or throwing a grenade spends no use.
freeze_help: Enemies stand still and stop attacking. In co-op, pair with Keep new enemies on the host.
gender_help: Switches the Helldiver between the male and female body.
give_backpack_help: Any backpack from the base game or an owned DLC. The one worn now drops to the ground.
give_perk_help: Swaps the perk for any other from the base game or an owned DLC. Laser sight needs a lobby with nobody else in it.
give_primary_help: Any primary weapon from the base game or an owned DLC, unlocked or not. The old one drops to the ground.
give_sidearm_help: Any sidearm from the base game or an owned DLC, unlocked or not. The old one drops to the ground.
give_stratagem_help: Adds the stratagem to the ones the player can call this mission. One already there gets a use back.
give_support_help: Any support weapon from the base game or an owned DLC, unlocked or not. The old one drops to the ground.
give_upgrades_help: Upgrades on the weapons and backpacks given below: the ones the account owns, none, or every one.
god_help: The player takes no damage and no status effects, falls and destroyed vehicles included. Scripted deaths still happen.
gravity_help: Pull on debris and loose objects: -18 is normal, nearer 0 floats. Helldivers walk as usual, and other players keep their own.
grenade_type_help: Swaps the grenades for frag, incendiary, stun or smoke.
heal_everyone_help: Full health for every player in the mission. Works as host or client.
heal_help: Full health, with every status effect removed.
heavy_armor_look_help: The bulky plating of the Heavy Armor perk, without the extra armor. Shows in missions only.
helmet_help: Any helmet from the base game or an owned DLC, unlocked or not.
hidden_help: Enemies stop targeting the player and go after teammates and bots instead.
hide_hud_help: Clears health, ammunition, stratagems and the rest of the HUD from the screen.
hide_model_help: The Helldiver body disappears from view. Enemies still see and hit the player.
host_owns_enemies: Keep new enemies on the host
host_owns_enemies_help: In co-op, each game runs some of the enemies. With this on, the host runs every new one, so enemy changes made there reach them all.
ignore_jammers_help: Stratagems can be called inside the zones that normally block them.
ignore_slow_help: Water, snow, barbed wire, poison, shocks and heavy loads no longer slow the player down.
infinite_respawns_help: Reinforcements never run out. The game counts them only with nobody else in the lobby.
auto_respawn_help: A dead player drops back in after 3 seconds, even with no reinforcements left and with other players in the lobby.
infinite_stamina_help: Stamina stays full, so sprinting never stops.
instant_call_in_help: Thrown flares call in at once instead of counting down.
instant_reload_help: Every reload finishes the moment it starts.
kill_all_help: Every enemy dies, with corpses and kill credit, so objectives count them.
kill_near_help: Corpses and kill credit for the player, so objectives count them.
lives_help: Reinforcements left in this mission. The game uses them only with nobody else in the lobby.
max_enemies_help: Most enemies at once, corpses included, normally 16. Waves follow it too, in place of 6 to 12 by difficulty. More enemies can slow the game.
music_none: This screen has no music to play.
music_pause_help: Pauses whatever plays. In a mission the music runs on silently and comes back further along.
music_release: Return the music to the game
music_release_help: The game chooses the music again, and threat and fight music fade back in.
music_stop_help: Holds silence in place of any music until the music returns to the game.
mutator_help: Special rules from the Proving Grounds challenge missions, in any mission: faster Helldivers, friendly fire that hits back, or stratagem drops near players.
mutator_orbital_bombardments_help: Proving Grounds rule, in any mission: a random strike lands near a random player every 15 seconds or so, after a warning. Host only.
mutator_orbital_support_help: Proving Grounds rule, in any mission: a random support stratagem lands near a random player every 20 seconds. Host only.
mutator_super_boots_help: Proving Grounds rule, in any mission: Helldivers move 40 percent faster on foot.
mutator_what_goes_around_help: Proving Grounds rule, in any mission: damage dealt to a teammate also hits the shooter.
mute_music_help: Holds the music at silent on every screen, whatever the game options say.
no_camera_shake_help: Explosions and heavy hits no longer shake the screen.
no_cooldown_help: Stratagems are ready again right after each call. Limited uses still run out.
no_dof_help: Removes the blur on things near and far from the camera focus.
no_fog_help: Removes the fog. Only this screen changes.
no_game_over_help: A full squad wipe doesn't end the mission, so everyone can still respawn.
no_screen_leash_help: The shared camera stops holding the player inside the screen, so the player can walk away from the squad.
no_spawns_help: Alarms and patrols bring no new enemies. Enemies already on the map stay.
no_status_help: Fire, poison, stuns, slowdowns and other status effects no longer reach the player.
noclip_help: The player moves through walls and terrain and can't fall off the map. Switch off before entering a vehicle or extracting.
objective_list_help: Every objective of the mission and how far along each one is.
outline_color_help: The outline that shows the player through walls and terrain.
patrol_count_help: Most patrols on the map at once. 0 keeps the mission default.
patrol_interval_help: How often a new patrol sets out, on maps with patrol spawners. 0 keeps the mission default.
pause_help: Stops game time, as a game speed of 0 would.
photo_mode_help: Freezes the camera and clears the screen. The game keeps running.
players_here_help: Everyone in the lobby, the host marked, with the ping of each.
practice_setup_help: A solo mission with a chosen planet, look, enemy, type, difficulty and layout, from the ship. Pays no XP or samples, like training.
practice_start_help: Starts the mission with the choices above. Works only from the ship with nobody else in the lobby.
protect_objectives_help: Convoy vehicles and escorted people take no damage. Reaches only what this game runs, so it works best as host.
refill_backpack_help: Backpacks with uses, such as the supply pack, go back to the most they hold.
refill_help: Full magazines in every weapon held, laser weapons cooled, and 2 grenades.
refill_uses_help: Stratagems with limited uses get all of them back.
refill_vehicle_help: Full ammunition for the guns and rockets of the vehicle the player drives.
regen_help: Hitpoints healed every second. A Helldiver has 100.
reinforce_cursor_help: Calls Reinforce under the mouse cursor and brings dead players back there. With nobody dead, the flare goes out.
remove_perk_help: Leaves the player with no perk.
repair_vehicle_help: Full health for the vehicle the player drives.
reset_cooldowns_help: Every stratagem on cooldown is ready to call again.
respawn_help: A dead player comes back at once instead of waiting for the respawn timer.
restart_objectives_help: Sets every objective back to the start.
reveal_map: Reveal hidden objects on the map
reveal_map_help: Shows everything the map would only show once found.
revive_everyone_help: Every downed player in the mission gets back up. Works as host or client.
revive_help: Brings a downed player back up. A dead player needs Respawn now instead.
seed_difficulty_help: From 1 to 15, as on the galaxy map. Higher difficulty sends more and tougher enemies.
seed_enemy_help: The faction the mission is fought against.
seed_environment_help: The planet type the mission is on: desert, forest, snow, lava or city.
seed_kind_help: Objectives to complete, a boss to kill, or Extermination: a set number of enemies to kill.
seed_time_help: Sets the light of the mission: dawn, day, dusk or night.
session_off: Trainer off: a player in the lobby has not allowed session mods. Every change is undone until that player leaves.
shield_help: A shield that takes this much damage before health does. It recharges a tenth of that per second, from 1 second after a hit.
show_patrols: Show every patrol on the map
show_patrols_help: The mission map shows the route of every patrol.
skip_waits_help: Objective countdowns, gaps between defense waves, the shuttle, respawn timers and cutscenes go by at once.
soundtrack_help: Chooses the music that plays. A chosen track holds through later screens until the music returns to the game.
spawn_ammo_help: An ammunition pickup on the spot, with no hellpod.
spawn_amount_help: Enemies per press, from 1 to 30. Spawning stops at 64 enemies on the map, corpses included.
spawn_crates_help: Crates that stratagems drop, placed on the spot with no hellpod or flare.
spawn_faction_help: Enemies of this faction by type. Only types this mission has loaded are listed.
spawn_group_help: One of the enemy groups the game builds waves from, 8 meters in front of the player.
spawn_pickups_help: Single items from supply crates, such as weapons and backpacks, ready to pick up.
spawn_samples_help: Research samples appear on every spot the map has for them.
spawn_wave_help: A wave of the mission faction, all at once, 10 meters in front of the player.
spawn_where_help: Where spawns appear: a few meters in front of the player, or under the mouse cursor.
spawned_some: Only %s fit: the map is full.
spectate_help: The camera follows another player. Only this screen changes.
spectate_self_help: The camera follows the local player again.
speed_help: Multiplies how fast the player moves, walking, sprinting and diving alike.
stun_near_help: A 3-second flashbang stun on every enemy within 20 meters.
sun_color_help: Tints the sunlight. Only this screen changes.
taunt_help: The line a Helldiver shouts now and then after a kill, on demand.
test_info_help: The game test text at the top of the screen: frame rate, mission seed and map position.
throw_range_help: Multiplies how far grenades and stratagem flares fly.
time_of_day_help: Lights the mission as dawn, day, dusk or night, whatever the seed says. Only this screen changes.
time_scale_help: Multiplies how fast the game runs. As host, this changes the game for everyone in the lobby.
tp_ahead_help: Moves the player 10 meters in the facing direction.
tp_cursor_help: Moves the player to the point under the mouse cursor.
tp_extraction_help: Moves the player to the landing zone of the extraction shuttle.
tp_objective_help: Moves the player to the first objective not yet done, extraction left out.
tp_spawn_help: Moves the player back to where the mission started.
tune_capacity_help: Multiplies rounds per magazine, or the heat a laser weapon holds before overheating.
tune_firerate_help: Multiplies shots per minute. Heat per shot drops by the same factor.
tune_page_help: Multipliers for whatever weapon the player holds in this slot, kept through swaps and respawns. Other copies of that weapon stay normal.
tune_pierce_help: Armor stops 15 less damage per hit, as with the armor-piercing upgrades. Flame weapons ignore this.
tune_power_help: Multiplies damage per hit. Armor comes off after, so more damage also gets through tougher armor.
tune_reload_help: Multiplies how fast reloads finish and how fast laser weapons cool down.
tune_reset_all_help: Every multiplier on the Individual weapon stats pages back to x1.
tune_reset_help: Every multiplier on this page back to x1, and armor piercing off.
tune_spread_help: Multiplies how far shots stray from the aim. 0 sends every shot straight.
unstick_help: Moves the player to the closest walkable point of the map, out of a rock, wall or hole.
vehicle_armor_help: Each hit on the driven vehicle loses this much damage, at any angle. 0 keeps the vehicle default.
vehicle_god_help: Any vehicle the player drives takes no damage. Passengers can't use this.
vehicle_riding: Riding: only the driver can change the vehicle
vehicle_rockets_help: The rocket pods of a driven exosuit refill as they fire.
vehicle_speed_help: Multiplies the speed of any vehicle the player drives.
vehicle_turn_help: Multiplies how fast a driven vehicle turns.
volume_music_help: Loudness of music in decibels: 0 is as the game mixes it, -60 is silent.
volume_sfx_help: Loudness of sound effects in decibels: 0 is as the game mixes it, -60 is silent.
volume_voices_help: Loudness of voices in decibels: 0 is as the game mixes it, -60 is silent.
why_alone_only: Only when nobody else is in the lobby.
why_denied: Refused: this command reaches the shared war, the save or paid content.
why_host_only: Only the host can do this.
why_map_full: The map is full. Clear some enemies first.
why_needs_flare: This stratagem needs a real flare.
why_no_avatar: Only while the player is on the field.
why_no_field: This item doesn't have that value.
why_not_cleared: Session mods are off in this lobby.
why_not_driving: Only the driver can do this.
why_not_ready: The game isn't ready for that yet.
why_out_of_range: That value is out of range.
why_protected: This value is protected and can't be edited.
why_seated: Get out of the vehicle first.
why_solo_only: Only with nobody else in the lobby.
why_spawns_off: Turn off No new enemies first.
why_unknown_bus: The game has no such volume.
why_unknown_faction: The game has no such faction.
why_unknown_shading: The game has no such value.
win_help: Ends the mission as a success with no shuttle, and every player counts as extracted.
seed_look_help: One of the planet's three terrain sets, or a faction's world as event planets have it: the bug world on desert, the cyborg world on snow, the illuminate world on forest. City has two terrain sets.
seed_layout_help: Which of the 215 maps the same choices can make. 0 picks one at random; the same number gives the same map again.
why_bad_choice: One of the choices is out of range.
why_look_not_here: This look doesn't exist on this planet type.
